benchmark: CIS AWS Compute Services Benchmark v2.0.0

results.title: Ensure Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) are encrypted
results.details: Tất cả 3 AMI đều có Encrypted=True (ami-0e8ae9b21ed993cb6, ami-0033a375ab8f52dab, ami-0b17c5bcd55b17b96)

results.title: Ensure Images (AMI) are not older than 90 days
results.details: Tất cả 3 AMI đều <= 90 ngày tuổi (tuổi tối đa: 28 ngày)

results.title: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled
results.details: EbsEncryptionByDefault=True và EBS Volume (vol-0ce1688c6b1af63c3) có Encrypted=True

results.title: Ensure Public Access to EBS Snapshots is Disabled
results.details: Snapshot Block Public Access='block-all-sharing' và 0/3 snapshot công khai

results.title: Ensure EBS volume snapshots are encrypted
results.details: Tất cả 3 EBS Snapshot đều có Encrypted=True (snap-0477a67c12d14ca67, snap-04003fbd64d5dca76, snap-0e52cef71fd051a00)

results.title: Ensure ECS task definitions using 'host' network mode do not allow privileged/root
results.details: Tất cả Task Definition (cis-compute-benchmark-task:6) không vi phạm host network + root/privileged.

results.title: Ensure 'assignPublicIp' is set to 'DISABLED' for Amazon ECS services
results.details: ECS Service (cis-compute-benchmark-service) có assignPublicIp='DISABLED'.
results.remediation_action: Đã cập nhật ECS Service với assignPublicIp='DISABLED'.

results.title: Ensure Amazon ECS task definitions do not have 'pidMode' set to 'host'
results.details: Không có Task Definition nào đặt pidMode='host' (cis-compute-benchmark-task:6).

results.title: Ensure Amazon ECS task definitions do not have 'privileged' set to 'true'
results.details: Tất cả container trong (cis-compute-benchmark-task:6) đều đặt privileged=False.

results.title: Ensure 'readonlyRootFilesystem' is set to 'true' for Amazon ECS task definitions
results.details: Tất cả container trong (cis-compute-benchmark-task:6) đều có readonlyRootFilesystem=True
results.remediation_action: Đã đăng ký Task Definition chuẩn CIS (cis-compute-benchmark-task:6) và hủy các revision vi phạm cũ.

results.title: Ensure secrets are not passed as container environment variables in ECS task definitions
results.details: Không có biến môi trường chứa secret plaintext trong (cis-compute-benchmark-task:6).

results.title: Ensure logging is configured for Amazon ECS task definitions
results.details: Tất cả container trong (cis-compute-benchmark-task:6) đã bật logDriver='awslogs'.

results.title: Ensure Amazon ECS Fargate services are using the latest Fargate platform version
results.details: Fargate Service đang dùng Platform Version mới nhất: cis-compute-benchmark-service(LATEST)

results.title: Ensure monitoring is enabled for Amazon ECS clusters
results.details: ECS Cluster đã bật giám sát Container Insights: cis-compute-benchmark-cluster (containerInsights=enabled)
results.remediation_action: Đã bật Container Insights (value='enabled') cho cluster 'cis-compute-benchmark-cluster'.

results.title: Ensure Amazon ECS services are tagged
results.details: Tất cả ECS Service đều đã gắn thẻ quản lý: cis-compute-benchmark-service (3 tags)

results.title: Ensure Amazon ECS clusters are tagged
results.details: Tất cả ECS Cluster đều đã gắn thẻ quản lý: cis-compute-benchmark-cluster (3 tags)

results.title: Ensure Amazon ECS task definitions are tagged
results.details: Tất cả Task Definition đều đã gắn thẻ: cis-compute-benchmark-task:6 (3 tags)

results.title: Ensure only trusted images are used with Amazon ECS
results.details: Chỉ sử dụng container image từ kho ECR nội bộ đáng tin cậy: cis-compute-benchmark-task:6 (cis-compute-benchmark-private-repo:latest)

results.title: Ensure 'assignPublicIp' is set to 'DISABLED' for Amazon ECS task sets
results.details: Tất cả ECS Task Set (cis-compute-benchmark-service/primary-taskset) đều có assignPublicIp='DISABLED'
results.remediation_action: Đã cập nhật ECS Task Set / Deployment với assignPublicIp='DISABLED'.

results.title: Ensure customer-managed keys are used to encrypt AWS Fargate ephemeral storage data
results.details: Đã mã hóa Fargate Ephemeral Storage bằng KMS CMK: cis-compute-benchmark-cluster (CMK: 7fff66f0-a18c-4f46-9e0a-a51a33d9e037)
results.remediation_action: Đã gắn KMS Customer-Managed Key (7fff66f0-a18c-4f46-9e0a-a51a33d9e037) vào managedStorageConfiguration của cluster 'cis-compute-benchmark-cluster'.

results.title: Ensure AWS Lambda Function URLs are configured to use AWS IAM authentication
results.details: Tất cả Lambda Function URL đều bắt buộc xác thực IAM: cis-compute-benchmark-lambda(AuthType=AWS_IAM)
results.remediation_action: Đã cập nhật Lambda Function URL sang AuthType='AWS_IAM' cho: cis-compute-benchmark-lambda
